batch.description: Jahangirnagar University A Unit (Mathematical & Physical Sciences), academic session 2018-2019, Set-P — full 80-question paper transcribed by direct visual reading of the Udvash 'জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক' (JU A & D Unit question bank), book PDF pp.76-79 (questions; printed answer table under the heading 'উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান' on p.79; printed worked solutions pp.79-80). EXTRACTION STAGE: all questions are marked content-UNVERIFIED and all keyed answers answer-UNVERIFIED — the printed publisher answer keys are preserved as-is and are NOT official JU keys; cross-source verification is a later stage. The book prints NO per-subject headings in this paper (only 'Short Syllabus' and 'Extra Syllabus' boxes) and the printed question numbers are NOT grouped in subject blocks — subjects here are assigned strictly by question content: Physics 23 (Q25-29, 34, 38-41, 43, 51-53, 55, 61, 71-77), Chemistry 20 (Q45-50, 54, 56-60, 62, 63, 65-70), Higher Mathematics 21 (Q5-10, 13, 14, 16-18, 20-24, 30-33, 35), Bangla 3 (Q36, 37, 44), English 3 (Q11, 15, 19), ICT 3 (Q1, 12, 42), General Knowledge 7 (Q2-4, 64, 78-80). Question numbers are also NOT in page order: p.76 prints Q1, 2, 5-7, 9-15, 17-22, 24-27 (under 'Short Syllabus'); p.77 prints Q28-31, 34, 36-42, 44, 48-52, 54-61; p.78 prints Q62-64, 66-69, 71, 74, 75, 78-80 and, in its right column, Q8, 16, 23, 32, 33, 35, 43, 45-47, 53, plus Q3-4 under an 'Extra Syllabus' box; p.79 prints Q65, 70, 72, 73, 76, 77 before the answer table. The answer table prints a dash at Q28 only, and the printed worked solution for Q28 (book PDF p.80) explicitly states '(সঠিক উত্তর নেই)' (no correct answer), giving a = −ω^2x, which is not among the printed options — so Q28 carries answerDisposition 'no_correct_option' with correctOptionIds []; its answerVerificationStatus is 'verified' solely because the validator requires that status for a no_correct_option disposition — it records the book's own printed claim, not cross-source verification — while its contentVerificationStatus remains 'unverified' like every other question in this extraction-stage pack. No dual keys occur in this paper. Worked solutions are printed for 39 questions (Short Syllabus section: 05, 06, 07, 09, 10, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 20, 21, 24, 26, 28, 30, 31, 34, 38, 39, 40, 48, 49, 50, 55, 58, 67, 69; Extra Syllabus section: 08, 16, 23, 32, 33, 35, 43, 53, 72, 76, 77); every printed solution letter agrees with the answer table. Preserved print anomalies: Q2's first word prints as 'শুরুমণ্ডলের' (apparent misprint); Q45 option (d) prints the formula '(NH4)2CO' without the final 3; Q60's stem prints the hydroxide ion as '-OH-'; Q65's four options are chemical-structure diagrams, described in words inside the option texts (no image asset bundled); Q66 prints a Latin 'A' as the label below its reaction arrow. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: Udvash জাবি প্রশ্নব্যাংক (JU A & D Unit question bank)
sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-P of JU A Unit 2018-2019 occupies book PDF pp.76-79 (printed book pp.75-78): questions pp.76-79, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা') on p.79, printed worked solutions pp.79-80 (printed p.79). Transcription by direct visual reading of every page (zoomed re-reads for the Q1/Q2 wording, the Q5 matrices, the Q9/Q28/Q29 options, Q36/Q37, Q44, Q45/Q46, Q57-Q60, Q62, Q65's structure diagrams, Q66's arrow label, Q72/Q73 and Q79/Q80). Mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, a/b for fractions, √, π, matrices as [[... , ...], ...]); chemical formula subscripts and symbol subscripts flattened to baseline digits (e.g. CaCl2, v0, i1), following the convention of the earlier packs from this book.
